```{r}
df_panc_derived_pre <- cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_pt_char %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_ca_dx,
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "institution", "release_version")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    cohort_panc_unique_cpt %>%
      group_by(cohort, record_id) %>%
      slice_min(cpt_number) %>%
      ungroup(),
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "institution", "release_version", "ca_seq")
  ) %>%
  ## 6/2026: skip as lung/peritoneum dist met status already present in data
  # left_join(
  #   .,
  #   all_bpc_ca_dx_derived_index %>%
  #     select(cohort, record_id, institution, ca_seq, dmets_lung, dmets_peritoneum),
  #   by = c("cohort", "record_id", "institution", "ca_seq")
  # ) %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    df_histology_reviewed %>%
      select(naaccr_histology_cd, naaccr_behavior_cd, who_classification) %>%
      rename(panc_histology_derived_pre = who_classification),
    by = c("naaccr_histology_cd", "naaccr_behavior_cd")
  ) %>%
  ## per meeting 1/31/2025, use oncotree code to infer histology for pts missing histology
  mutate(
    panc_histology_derived = case_when(
      !is.na(panc_histology_derived_pre) ~ panc_histology_derived_pre,
      is.na(panc_histology_derived_pre) &
        cpt_oncotree_code == "PAAC" ~ "Acinar cell carcinoma",
      is.na(panc_histology_derived_pre) &
        cpt_oncotree_code == "PAAD" ~ "Duct adenocarcinoma, NOS",
      is.na(panc_histology_derived_pre) &
        cpt_oncotree_code %in% c("PAASC", "UCP") ~ "Other"
    ),
    adv_disease_cpt_mos_pre = case_when(
      pfs_cohort == "Stage IV" ~ dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      pfs_cohort == "Stage I-III with Distant Mets" ~ dx_cpt_rep_mos - dx_to_dmets_mos
    ),
    adv_disease_cpt_mos = case_when(
      adv_disease_cpt_mos_pre < 0 ~ 0,
      adv_disease_cpt_mos_pre >= 0 ~ adv_disease_cpt_mos_pre
    ),
    stage_dx_grouped = case_when(
      stage_dx %in% c("Stage I", "Stage IV") ~ stage_dx,
      stage_dx %in% c("Stage II", "Stage III", "Stage I-III NOS") ~ "Stage II/III"
    ),
    naaccr_race_grouped = case_when(
      naaccr_race_code_primary %in% c("Asian Indian", "Chinese", "Other Asian") ~ "Asian",
      naaccr_race_code_primary %in% c("Native American", "Other", "Unknown") ~ "Other/unknown",
      TRUE ~ naaccr_race_code_primary
    ),
    ## 6/2026: variable levels re-encoded in panc 1.0-public so skip manual grouping
    naaccr_ethnicity_code_grouped = factor(
      case_when(
        naaccr_ethnicity_code %in% c("Not Collected", "Unknown") ~ "Unknown ethnicity",
        TRUE ~ naaccr_ethnicity_code
      ),
      levels = c("Spanish/Hispanic", "Non-Spanish/non-Hispanic", "Unknown ethnicity")
    ),
    # case_when(
    #   naaccr_ethnicity_code %in% c(
    #     "Dominican Republic",
    #     "Mexican (includes Chicano)",
    #     "Other specified Spanish/Hispanic origin (includes European; excludes Dominican Republic)",
    #     "South or Central American (except Brazil)",
    #     "Spanish NOS or Hispanic NOS or Latino NOS",
    #     "Spanish surname only") ~ "Hispanic or Latino",
    #   naaccr_ethnicity_code == "Non-Spanish; non-Hispanic" ~ "Not Hispanic or Latino",
    #   naaccr_ethnicity_code == "Unknown whether Spanish or not" ~ "Unknown ethnicity"
    # ),
    ca_resect_status_derived = factor(
      case_when(
        ca_resect_status == "Indeterminate" ~ "Unknown resectability status",
        !is.na(ca_resect_status) ~ ca_resect_status,
        is.na(ca_resect_status) ~ "Unknown resectability status"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Resectable",
        "Borderline resectable",
        "Unresectable/locally advanced or metastatic",
        "Unknown resectability status"
      )
    ),
    ca_resect_status_derived_no_unknown =
      factor(
        case_when(
          !is.na(ca_resect_status) &
            ca_resect_status != "Indeterminate" ~ ca_resect_status,
          ca_resect_status == "Indeterminate" ~ NA_character_,
          is.na(ca_resect_status) ~ NA_character_
        ),
        levels = c(
          "Resectable",
          "Borderline resectable",
          "Unresectable/locally advanced or metastatic"
        )
      )
  )

df_sample_type_dfci_pre <-

df_sample_type_dfci <- dplyr::rename(df_sample_type_dfci_pre, cpt_genie_sample_id = `.`) %>%
  mutate(reviewed_sample_type = "Primary tumor")

df_panc_derived_1 <- df_panc_derived_pre %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    df_panc_derived_pre %>%
      left_join(
        .,
        cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_ca_radtx %>% mutate(received_rt_pre = 1),
        by = c("cohort", "record_id", "institution", "ca_seq")
      ) %>%
      mutate(received_rt = case_when(received_rt_pre == 1 ~ 1, is.na(received_rt_pre) ~ 0)) %>%
      group_by(cohort, record_id, institution, ca_seq) %>%
      summarize(any_rt = max(received_rt), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "institution", "ca_seq")
  ) %>%
  # select(record_id,
  #        cpt_report_post_death,
  #        cpt_report_post_last_alive,
  #        panc_histology_derived) %>%
  # View()

  ## exclude patients whose CPT report was returned post death/last known alive
  ## per deb, exclude 5 patients with neuroendocrine histology (very different cancer type)
  filter(
    cpt_report_post_death %in% c(0, NA),
    cpt_report_post_last_alive %in% c(0, NA),
    panc_histology_derived %in% c("Acinar cell carcinoma", "Duct adenocarcinoma, NOS", "Other", NA)
  ) %>%
  rename(sample_type_orig = sample_type) %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    df_sample_type_dfci,
    by = "cpt_genie_sample_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = case_when(
    !is.na(reviewed_sample_type) ~ reviewed_sample_type,
    is.na(reviewed_sample_type) ~ sample_type_orig
  )) %>%
  labelled::set_variable_labels(
    institution = "Institution",
    age_dx = "Age at diagnosis",
    stage_dx = "Stage at diagnosis",
    stage_dx_iv = "Stage at diagnosis",
    naaccr_sex_code = "Sex",
    naaccr_race_grouped = "Race",
    naaccr_ethnicity_code_grouped = "Ethnicity",

    ## 6/2026: in panc 1.0-public, dmets variable names were updated to [dist_mets_*];
    ## variable classification was updated to abdomen, adrenal, bone, bone_marrow,
    ## brain_cns, breast, head_and_neck, liver, lymph_nodes, pelvis,
    ## pericardial_and_malignant_pericardial_effusion,
    ## peritoneum_and_malignant_peritoneal_effusion,
    ## pleura_and_malignant_pleural_effusion, pulmonary, skin, thorax, and other
    dist_mets_liver = "Distant metastasis in liver",
    dist_mets_brain_cns = "Distant metastasis in brain",
    dist_mets_pulmonary = "Distant metastasis in lung",
    dist_mets_peritoneum_and_malignant_peritoneal_effusion = "Distant metastasis in peritoneum",
    cpt_oncotree_code = "NGS OncoTree code",
    panc_histology_derived = "Pancreas histology (WHO classification)",
    stage_dx_grouped = "Stage at diagnosis",
    any_rt = "Received radiation therapy associated with cancer diagnosis",
    ca_resect_status_derived = "Tumor resectability status",
  )
```

```{r}
# Investigational Drug, 338, Unknown
# , 51, Unknown
# Other NOS, 4, Unknown
chemo_drugs <-read.csv(here::here(out.dir, "df_panc_drugs_annotated.csv")) %>% 
  filter(drug_type == 'Chemotherapy') %>% pull(drug)

# unknown/masked drugs
unknown_drugs <- c("Investigational Drug", "Other NOS", "Other")


df_chemo_pre_proc <- df_panc_derived_1 %>%
 # acquire path procedure date for tumor sample
 left_join(
    cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_prissmm_pathology %>%
      select(
        cohort, record_id, path_proc_number, path_proc_int
        ),
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "path_proc_number")
  ) %>% 
  select(cohort, record_id, dob_ca_dx_days, path_proc_int, ca_seq) %>%
  # acquire regimen end date to compare against path proc date
  left_join(., cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_ca_drugs %>% 
    select(
      cohort, record_id, ca_seq, regimen_number, regimen_drugs, 
      drugs_startdt_int_1, dx_drug_end_int_1, dx_drug_start_int_1
    ),
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "ca_seq")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # calculate time from dx to sample acquisition
    tt_dx_proc_days = path_proc_int - dob_ca_dx_days,
    tt_dx_proc_mos = tt_dx_proc_days / 30.44,
    
    # check if any chemo drug in the regimen string
    is_chemo = sapply(regimen_drugs, function(x) {
      drugs <- trimws(strsplit(x, ",")[[1]])
      any(drugs %in% chemo_drugs)
    }),
    
    # check if regimen is entirely unknown
    is_unknown = sapply(regimen_drugs, function(x) {
      drugs <- trimws(strsplit(x, ",")[[1]])
      all(sapply(drugs, function(d) any(sapply(unknown_drugs, function(p) grepl(p, d, fixed = TRUE)))))
    }),
    
    # get interval from dob to regimen end using drug 1 as approximate 
    regimen_end_int = drugs_startdt_int_1 + (dx_drug_end_int_1 - dx_drug_start_int_1),
    
    # encoode indicator of any chemo prior to tumor acquisition
    chemo_pre_proc = case_when(
      is.na(regimen_end_int) | is_unknown ~ NA,
      (regimen_end_int < path_proc_int) & is_chemo ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(cohort, record_id, ca_seq) %>% 
  slice_max(chemo_pre_proc, with_ties = F) %>% ungroup()

df_panc_derived <- df_panc_derived_1 %>% 
  left_join(
    df_chemo_pre_proc %>% 
      select(cohort, record_id, ca_seq, chemo_pre_proc, tt_dx_proc_days, tt_dx_proc_mos),
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "ca_seq")
  ) %>%
  labelled::set_variable_labels(
    chemo_pre_proc = "Received chemotherapy prior to tumor sample acquisition"
  )

rm(df_panc_derived_1)
```

```{r, eval=F, include=F}
# Load genomic data: from cBioPortal -----------------------------------
# reference: https://mskcc-epi-bio.github.io/genomeverse/articles/genie-bpc-vignette.html
cbioportalR::set_cbioportal_db("https://genie.cbioportal.org/api")

mutations_extended_panc <- get_mutations_by_study("panc_public_genie_bpc")
sv_panc <- get_structural_variants_by_study("panc_public_genie_bpc")
cna_panc <- get_cna_by_study("panc_public_genie_bpc")

## save out genomic data so don't need to pull it from cBio every time
save(
  mutations_extended_panc,
  sv_panc,
  cna_panc,
  file = here::here(out.dir, "panc_genie_bpc_genomic_data.rdata")
)
```

```{r}
load(here::here(out.dir, "panc_genie_bpc_genomic_data.rdata"))

# ## Alternative: load from Synapse --------------------------------
# ## Note: less preferred than using cbioportal genomic data
# mutations_extended_panc <-
#   panc_v1_0$PANC_v1.0$mutations_extended %>%
#   rename(sample_id = Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

# sv_panc <- panc_v1_0$PANC_v1.0$sv %>%
#   rename(sample_id = Sample_Id)

# cna_panc <- pivot_cna_longer(panc_v1_0$PANC_v1.0$cna) %>% 
#   ### note 6/25/2026: filter out loss/gain of functions
#   filter(!tolower(alteration) %in% c("loss", "gain"))

sample_panels <- df_panc_derived %>%
  select(
    sample_id = cpt_genie_sample_id, 
    panel_id = cpt_seq_assay_id,
    tt_dx_proc_days,
    stage = stage_dx_iv,
    any_chemo = chemo_pre_proc
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(panel_id))

## include mutations, fusions, cna
gen_dat_binary <-
  create_gene_binary(
    mutation = mutations_extended_panc,
    fusion = sv_panc,
    cna = cna_panc,
    samples = sample_panels$sample_id,
    specify_panel = sample_panels,
    recode_aliases = "genie"
  ) %>%
  ## per slack with Karissa 27NOV2024 filter out columns entirely missing to address following message:
  ## ! 87 columns have all missing values. This may occur when there are genes in your data that are not in the specified panels (see `specify_panel` argument)
  ## ! 42 `samples` had no alterations found in data sets (See `attr(<your_df>, 'zero_alteration_samples')` to view). These were retained in results as having 0 alterations.
  select_if(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))

gen_dat_summary <- gen_dat_binary %>%
  summarize_by_gene()

## mutations only
gen_dat_binary_mut_only <-
  create_gene_binary(
    mutation = mutations_extended_panc,
    samples = sample_panels$sample_id,
    specify_panel = sample_panels,
    recode_aliases = "genie"
  ) %>%
  ## per slack with Karissa 27NOV2024 filter out columns entirely missing to address following message:
  ## ! 23 columns have all missing values. This may occur when there are genes in your data that are not in the specified panels (see `specify_panel` argument)
  select_if(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
## load oncokb annotated data
load(here::here(out.dir, "panc_v1_0_oncokb_annotation.rdata"))

## include mutations, fusions, cna
gen_dat_binary_oncokb <-
  create_gene_binary(
    mutation = oncokb_mutations_extended_panc %>%
      filter(oncokb_oncogenic %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely Oncogenic")),
    fusion = oncokb_sv_panc %>%
      filter(oncokb_oncogenic %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely Oncogenic")),
    cna = oncokb_cna_panc %>%
      filter(oncokb_oncogenic %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely Oncogenic")),
    samples = sample_panels$sample_id,
    specify_panel = sample_panels,
    recode_aliases = "genie"
  ) %>%
  ## per slack with Karissa 27NOV2024 filter out columns entirely missing to address following message:
  ## ! 27 columns have all missing values. This may occur when there are genes in your data that are not in the specified panels (see `specify_panel` argument)
  select_if(function(x) !all(is.na(x))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(., "_oncokb"), -sample_id)

gen_dat_summary_oncokb <- gen_dat_binary_oncokb %>%
  summarize_by_gene()

## mutations only
gen_dat_binary_mut_only_oncokb <-
  create_gene_binary(
    mutation = oncokb_mutations_extended_panc %>%
      filter(oncokb_oncogenic %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely Oncogenic")),
    samples = sample_panels$sample_id,
    specify_panel = sample_panels,
    recode_aliases = "genie"
  ) %>%
  ## per slack with Karissa 27NOV2024 filter out columns entirely missing to address following message:
  ## ! 69 columns have all missing values. This may occur when there are genes in your data that are not in the specified panels (see `specify_panel` argument)
  select_if(function(x) !all(is.na(x))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(., "_oncokb"), -sample_id)
```

# Overview

There were `r nrow(panc_v1_0$PANC_v1.0$pt_char)` patients diagnosed with pancreatic cancer who were included in the GENIE BPC PANC v1.0-public data release. After excluding `r n_pts_excluded_cpt` patients with next generation sequencing reports returned after death or last known alive date, `r n_pts_excluded_neuroendocrine` patients with pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasm histology, and 1 patient with benign tumor, this analysis considers `r nrow(df_panc_derived)` total patients. 

## Notes 

- For patients with >1 NGS report available, only their first NGS report was considered for the analysis.
- Per Deb's recommendation, stage at diagnosis is categorized as stage I (localized), stage II/III (locally advanced), and stage IV (advanced). Patients diagnosed with stage II, III, and I-III NOS disease were defined as "Stage II/III."
- There are 3 patients (GENIE-MSK-P-0019433, GENIE-DFCI-047682-249649, GENIE-UHN-OCT508828-ARC1) in the overall pancreas data that had IGF2 alterations, two of whom remained in the analytic cohort. One patient (GENIE-MSK-P-0019433) was excluded from the analyses because their NGS report was returned after last follow-up.
- As of 2/14/2025, using genomic data from Synapse
- ***NEW 6/22/2026***
      
    -   Using pancreas data **v1.0-public** (genomic data from GENIE **v19.0-public**) to run re-analysis for the manuscript revision
    -   In this iteration, 1 patient (GENIE-MSK-P-0005758) was exclued as their `naaccr_behavior_cd`changed from 2 (1.2-consortium) to 3 (1.0-public) and therefore was mapped to diagnosis type "*Benign epithelial tumors and precursos*" that was deemed ineligible for inclusion in the analysis, resulting in a total sample size of N=1040.
    -   As of 6/20/2026, using genomic data from cbioportal which already filtered out loss(-1) and gain(+1) CNAs and silent, intron, etc. mutation events (see : ) 
    -   Germine analysis: per Henry Walch 6/20/2026, reran with v19.0-public AND incorporated oncoKB germline annotation with additional manual filtering for likely pathogenic germline events.

# Baseline characteristics

- [Pancreas histology WHO classification](https://www.pathologyoutlines.com/topic/pancreaswho.html) was derived from `naaccr_histology_cd` and `naaccr_behavior_cd` if available. For patients missing `naaccr_histology_cd` and `naaccr_behavior_cd`, the pancreas histology WHO classification was derived from `cpt_oncotree_code`.
- Tumor resectability status was recorded at the time of clinical staging prior to any cancer-directed drugs and/or radiation therapy giving preference to the internal oncologists in the following order: 1. Medical Oncologist; 2. Surgical Oncologist; 3. Radiation Oncologist
  - Resectability statuses of "indeterminate" were set to missing

## Summary of n diagnoses

```{r}
bind_rows(
  panc_v1_0$PANC_v1.0$ca_dx_index %>%
    select(cohort, record_id, ca_seq, ca_type, redcap_ca_index),
  panc_v1_0$PANC_v1.0$ca_dx_non_index %>%
    select(cohort, record_id, ca_seq, ca_type, redcap_ca_index)
) %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    df_panc_derived %>%
      select(cohort, record_id, ca_seq, ca_type, redcap_ca_index) %>%
      mutate(analytic_cohort_pre = 1),
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "ca_seq", "ca_type", "redcap_ca_index")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    analytic_cohort = case_when(
      analytic_cohort_pre == 1 ~ 1,
      is.na(analytic_cohort_pre) ~ 0
    ),
    redcap_ca_index_num = case_when(
      redcap_ca_index == "Yes" ~ 1,
      redcap_ca_index == "No" ~ 0
    ),
    ca_type_panc_num = case_when(
      ca_type == "Pancreatic Cancer" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-contains("pre")) %>%
  group_by(cohort, record_id) %>%
  summarize(
    n_index_ca = sum(redcap_ca_index_num),
    n_dx_panc = sum(ca_type_panc_num),
    n_dx_total = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(record_id %in% c(df_panc_derived %>% select(record_id) %>% unlist())) %>%
  select(starts_with("n_")) %>%
  tbl_summary(label = list(
    n_index_ca = "N index cancers",
    n_dx_panc = "N pancreatic cancers",
    n_dx_total = "N total cancer diagnoses"
  ))
```

Each of these patients has only 1 NGS report available.*

```{r}
    sample_type %in% c("Primary tumor", "Local recurrence") ~ sample_type,

    type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ c(
      "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      "{min}, {max}"
    ),
    sort = list(sample_type_grouped ~ "frequency")
  )
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# gen_dat_summary %>%

#########################################
# WITHOUT ONCOKB ANNOTATION -------------
#########################################

freq_genes_tested_20pct_pts <- gen_dat_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(-sample_id),
    names_to = "gene",
    values_to = "alteration"
  ) %>%
  mutate(n_samples = n_distinct(sample_id)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarize(
    n_alterations = sum(alteration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples_gene = sum(!is.na(alteration)),
    pct_samples_gene = n_samples_gene / mean(n_samples),
    pct_alterations = n_alterations / n_samples_gene,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unique() %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_alterations)) %>%
  filter(pct_samples_gene >= 0.20) %>%
  filter(pct_alterations >= 0.03) %>%
  select(gene)

gen_dat_tested_20pct_pts <- gen_dat_summary %>%
  select(
    sample_id,
    all_of(
      freq_genes_tested_20pct_pts %>% select(gene) %>% unlist() %>% as.vector()
    ),
    BARD1, IGF2, PALB2
  )

#######################################################
# restricted to oncogenic/likely oncogenic genes ------
#######################################################

gen_dat_tested_20pct_pts_oncokb <- gen_dat_summary_oncokb %>%
  select(
    sample_id,
    any_of(
      freq_genes_tested_20pct_pts %>%
        mutate(gene_oncokb = paste0(gene, "_oncokb")) %>%
        select(gene_oncokb) %>%
        unlist() %>%
        as.vector()
    ),
    ## BARD1/IGF2 not in oncokb annotated data
    # BARD1, IGF2
    PALB2_oncokb
  )
```

### Frequencies of genomic alterations {.tabset .tabsetfade}

*The table below considers any mutation, structural variant, or CNA as an alteration. Genes altered in at least 3% of samples and included on at least 20% of sample panels are shown, as well as BARD1, IGF2 and PALB2 due to clinical relevance.*

```{r, include = FALSE}
## for oncoprint
top_25_alt_oncokb <- gen_dat_tested_20pct_pts_oncokb %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("_oncokb", "", .), -sample_id) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(-sample_id),
    names_to = "gene_name",
    values_to = "alt_status"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarize(
    n_row = n(),
    n_alt = sum(alt_status, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct_alt = n_alt / n_row) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_alt)) %>%
  top_n(n = 25) %>%
  select(gene_name)

top_25_alt_oncokb %>%
  unlist() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  gt::gt()

sample_panels$sample_id %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  gt::gt()
```

```{r}
          ARID1A == 0 &

            PALB2 == 0 ~ 0,
          is.na(ARID1A) &
            is.na(ATM) &
            is.na(BARD1) &
            is.na(BRCA1) &
            is.na(BRCA2) &
            is.na(PALB2) ~ as.numeric(NA)
        )

      select(sample_id, any_ddr),
    by = c("cpt_genie_sample_id" = "sample_id")
  ) %>%
  filter(any_ddr == 1) %>%
  left_join(., cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_ca_drugs,
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "institution", "ca_seq")
  ) %>%
  mutate(any_olaparib_pre = case_when(
    grepl("Olaparib", regimen_drugs) ~ 1,
    !grepl("Olaparib", regimen_drugs) ~ 0
  )) %>%
  group_by(cohort, record_id) %>%
  summarize(any_olaparib = max(any_olaparib_pre), .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(any_olaparib) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(any_olaparib = "Received Olaparib at any time")
  )
```

### Frequency of patients with KRAS G12C, G12D, G12R, G12V, and Q61 (summarized using the mutations data only) {.tabset .tabsetfade}

#### Restricted to oncogenic/likely oncogenic genes

*Note: Patients considered as "no" below include unknown/non-oncogenic KRAS alterations and patients without KRAS alterations.*

```{r}
## summarize freq of pts with KRAS G12D and KRAS G12R
identify_kras_g12d_g12r_g12v_oncokb <- oncokb_mutations_extended_panc %>%
  filter(oncokb_oncogenic %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely Oncogenic")) %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = case_when(
      !grepl("MSK", sample_id) ~ sub("(^([^\\-]*\\-){2}[^\\-]*).*", "\\1", sample_id),
      grepl("MSK", sample_id) ~ sub("(^([^\\-]*\\-){3}[^\\-]*).*", "\\1", sample_id)
    ),
    protein_change = gsub("p.", "", hgv_sp_short)
  ) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% c(sample_panels %>% select(sample_id) %>%
    unlist())) %>%
  select(sample_id, patient_id, hugo_symbol, protein_change) %>%
  mutate(
    kras_g12c_pre = case_when(
      hugo_symbol == "KRAS" & protein_change == "G12C" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12d_pre = case_when(
      hugo_symbol == "KRAS" & protein_change == "G12D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12r_pre = case_when(
      hugo_symbol == "KRAS" & protein_change == "G12R" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12v_pre = case_when(
      hugo_symbol == "KRAS" & protein_change == "G12V" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    kras_q61_pre = case_when(
      hugo_symbol == "KRAS" & grepl("Q61", protein_change) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarize(
    kras_g12c_oncokb = max(kras_g12c_pre),
    kras_g12d_oncokb = max(kras_g12d_pre),
    kras_g12r_oncokb = max(kras_g12r_pre),
    kras_g12v_oncokb = max(kras_g12v_pre),
    kras_q61_oncokb = max(kras_q61_pre),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## merge onto analytic cohort to get total # of patients as denominator
df_panc_derived %>%
  left_join(., identify_kras_g12d_g12r_g12v_oncokb, by = c("record_id" = "patient_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    kras_g12c_oncokb = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_g12c_oncokb) ~ kras_g12c_oncokb,
      is.na(kras_g12c_oncokb) ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12d_oncokb = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_g12d_oncokb) ~ kras_g12d_oncokb,
      is.na(kras_g12d_oncokb) ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12r_oncokb = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_g12r_oncokb) ~ kras_g12r_oncokb,
      is.na(kras_g12r_oncokb) ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12v_oncokb = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_g12v_oncokb) ~ kras_g12v_oncokb,
      is.na(kras_g12v_oncokb) ~ 0
    ),
    kras_q61_oncokb = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_q61_oncokb) ~ kras_q61_oncokb,
      is.na(kras_q61_oncokb) ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    kras_g12c_oncokb,
    kras_g12d_oncokb,
    kras_g12r_oncokb,
    kras_g12v_oncokb,
    kras_q61_oncokb,
    stage_dx_iv
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(
      kras_g12c_oncokb = "KRAS G12C",
      kras_g12d_oncokb = "KRAS G12D",
      kras_g12r_oncokb = "KRAS G12R",
      kras_g12v_oncokb = "KRAS G12V",
      kras_q61_oncokb = "KRAS Q61"
    ),
    by = stage_dx_iv
  ) %>%
  add_overall()
```

```{r}
## summarize freq of pts with KRAS G12D and KRAS G12R
identify_kras_g12d_g12r_g12v <- mutations_extended_panc %>%
  # rename(sampleId = Tumor_Sample_Barcode, hugoGeneSymbol = Hugo_Symbol) %>%
  # mutate(
  #   patientId = case_when(
  #     !grepl("MSK", sampleId) ~ sub("(^([^\\-]*\\-){2}[^\\-]*).*", "\\1", sampleId),
  #     grepl("MSK", sampleId) ~ sub("(^([^\\-]*\\-){3}[^\\-]*).*", "\\1", sampleId)
  #   ),
  #   proteinChange = gsub("p.", "", HGVSp_Short)
  # ) %>%
  filter(sampleId %in% c(sample_panels %>% select(sample_id) %>%
    unlist())) %>%
  select(sampleId, patientId, hugoGeneSymbol, proteinChange) %>%
  mutate(
    kras_g12c_pre = case_when(
      hugoGeneSymbol == "KRAS" & proteinChange == "G12C" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12d_pre = case_when(
      hugoGeneSymbol == "KRAS" & proteinChange == "G12D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12r_pre = case_when(
      hugoGeneSymbol == "KRAS" & proteinChange == "G12R" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12v_pre = case_when(
      hugoGeneSymbol == "KRAS" & proteinChange == "G12V" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    kras_q61_pre = case_when(
      hugoGeneSymbol == "KRAS" & grepl("Q61", proteinChange) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(patientId) %>%
  summarize(
    kras_g12c = max(kras_g12c_pre),
    kras_g12d = max(kras_g12d_pre),
    kras_g12r = max(kras_g12r_pre),
    kras_g12v = max(kras_g12v_pre),
    kras_q61 = max(kras_q61_pre),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## merge onto analytic cohort to get total # of patients as denominator
df_panc_derived %>%
  left_join(., identify_kras_g12d_g12r_g12v, by = c("record_id" = "patientId")) %>%
  mutate(
    kras_g12c = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_g12c) ~ kras_g12c,
      is.na(kras_g12c) ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12d = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_g12d) ~ kras_g12d,
      is.na(kras_g12d) ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12r = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_g12r) ~ kras_g12r,
      is.na(kras_g12r) ~ 0
    ),
    kras_g12v = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_g12v) ~ kras_g12v,
      is.na(kras_g12v) ~ 0
    ),
    kras_q61 = case_when(
      !is.na(kras_q61) ~ kras_q61,
      is.na(kras_q61) ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  select(kras_g12c, kras_g12d, kras_g12r, kras_g12v, kras_q61, stage_dx_iv) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(
      kras_g12c = "KRAS G12C",
      kras_g12d = "KRAS G12D",
      kras_g12r = "KRAS G12R",
      kras_g12v = "KRAS G12V",
      kras_q61 = "KRAS Q61"
    ),
    by = stage_dx_iv
  ) %>%
  add_overall()
```

### Frequency of KRASmut patients without KRAS G12C, G12D, G12R, G12V, and Q61 (summarized using the mutations data only) {.tabset .tabsetfade}

#### Restricted to oncogenic/likely oncogenic genes

*Note: Patients considered as "no" below include unknown/non-oncogenic KRAS alterations and patients without KRAS alterations.*

```{r}
oncokb_mutations_extended_panc %>%
  filter(oncokb_oncogenic %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely Oncogenic")) %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = case_when(
      !grepl("MSK", sample_id) ~ sub("(^([^\\-]*\\-){2}[^\\-]*).*", "\\1", sample_id),
      grepl("MSK", sample_id) ~ sub("(^([^\\-]*\\-){3}[^\\-]*).*", "\\1", sample_id)
    ),
    protein_change = gsub("p.", "", hgv_sp_short)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    hugo_symbol == "KRAS",
    !(protein_change %in% c("G12C", "G12D", "G12R", "G12V")),
    !grepl("Q61", protein_change)
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarize(
    n_kras_mut = n(),
    protein_change_concat_pre = paste0(sort(unique(protein_change)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    protein_change_concat = case_when(
      protein_change_concat_pre == "" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ protein_change_concat_pre
    )
  ) %>%
  select(protein_change_concat) %>%
  tbl_summary(label = list(protein_change_concat = "KRAS protein change"))
```

## Co-occurrence plots {.tabset .tabsetfade}

*Note: the genes shown below are restricted to mutations only (structural variants and CNA are not included in the analyses below).* 

The percentages below represent the proportion of mutated patients among the subpopulation of patients with each KRAS protein change.

### Restricted to oncogenic/likely-oncogenic

```{r}
## reference: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/how-to-create-correlation-heatmap-in-r/
test_gene_comutation_oncokb <- df_panc_derived %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    gen_dat_binary_mut_only_oncokb %>% janitor::clean_names(),
    by = c("cpt_genie_sample_id" = "sample_id")
  ) %>%
  left_join(.,
    identify_kras_g12d_g12r_g12v_oncokb,
    by = c("record_id" = "patient_id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    kras_g12c_oncokb = case_when(kras_oncokb == 1 &
      kras_g12c_oncokb == 1 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    kras_g12d_oncokb = case_when(kras_oncokb == 1 &
      kras_g12d_oncokb == 1 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    kras_g12r_oncokb = case_when(kras_oncokb == 1 &
      kras_g12r_oncokb == 1 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    kras_g12v_oncokb = case_when(kras_oncokb == 1 &
      kras_g12v_oncokb == 1 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    kras_q61_oncokb = case_when(kras_oncokb == 1 &
      kras_q61_oncokb == 1 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    kras_other_allele_oncokb = case_when(kras_oncokb == 1 &
      ((kras_g12c_oncokb %in% c(0, NA)) &
        (kras_g12d_oncokb %in% c(0, NA)) &
        (kras_g12r_oncokb %in% c(0, NA)) &
        (kras_g12v_oncokb %in% c(0, NA)) &
        (kras_q61_oncokb %in% c(0, NA))
      ) ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)
  ) %>%
  select(
    record_id,
    kras_oncokb,
    kras_g12c_oncokb,
    kras_g12d_oncokb,
    kras_g12r_oncokb,
    kras_g12v_oncokb,
    kras_q61_oncokb,
    kras_other_allele_oncokb,
    tp53_oncokb,
    smad4_oncokb,
    cdkn2a_oncokb,
    brca1_oncokb,
    brca2_oncokb,
    palb2_oncokb
  )
```

```{r}
co_occurrence_kras_oncokb <-
  test_gene_comutation_oncokb %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("kras"),
    names_to = "kras_type",
    values_to = "kras_value"
  ) %>%
  filter(kras_value == 1) %>%
  select(kras_type, everything(), -record_id) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("_oncokb"),
    names_to = "gene_name",
    values_to = "alt_status",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  group_by(kras_type, gene_name) %>%
  summarize(
    kras_type_sum = sum(kras_value),
    alt_status_sum = sum(alt_status, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct_altered = round((alt_status_sum / kras_type_sum) * 100, 2)) %>%
  mutate(
    kras_type_clean = case_when(
      kras_type == "kras_oncokb" ~ "All KRAS",
      kras_type == "kras_g12c_oncokb" ~ "KRAS G12C",
      kras_type == "kras_g12d_oncokb" ~ "KRAS G12D",
      kras_type == "kras_g12r_oncokb" ~ "KRAS G12R",
      kras_type == "kras_g12v_oncokb" ~ "KRAS G12V",
      kras_type == "kras_q61_oncokb" ~ "KRAS Q61",
      kras_type == "kras_other_allele_oncokb" ~ "Other KRAS alleles"
    ),
    gene_name_clean = case_when(
      gene_name == "tp53_oncokb" ~ "TP53",
      gene_name == "smad4_oncokb" ~ "SMAD4",
      gene_name == "cdkn2a_oncokb" ~ "CDKN2A",
      gene_name == "brca1_oncokb" ~ "BRCA1",
      gene_name == "brca2_oncokb" ~ "BRCA2",
      gene_name == "palb2_oncokb" ~ "PALB2"
    ),
    pct_altered_char = paste0(pct_altered, "%")
  )
```

# Summary of cancer-directed drugs regimens

The following patients did not have any cancer-directed drug regimens associated with their cancer diagnosis:

```{r}
df_panc_derived %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_ca_drugs %>%
      group_by(cohort, record_id, ca_seq) %>%
      summarize(n_reg_per_dx = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "ca_seq")
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(n_reg_per_dx)) %>%
  select(stage_dx_iv) %>%
  tbl_summary()
```

```{r, message = FALSE}
top_first_reg_by_stage <- df_panc_derived %>%
  left_join(., cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_ca_drugs,
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "institution", "ca_seq")
  ) %>%
  group_by(cohort, record_id) %>%
  filter(!is.na(regimen_drugs)) %>%
  slice_min(regimen_number) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(., regimen_abbreviations, by = "regimen_drugs") %>%
  mutate(
    regimen_drugs_abbrev_pre = case_when(
      !is.na(abbreviation) ~ abbreviation,
      is.na(abbreviation) ~ regimen_drugs
    ),
    regimen_drugs_group_pre = case_when(
      regimen_drugs_abbrev_pre %in% c("FOLFOX", "FOLFOXIRI", "FOLFIRI", "Capecitabine") ~ "5FU-containing",
      grepl("Gemcitabine Hydrochloride", regimen_drugs_abbrev_pre) ~ "Gemcitabine-containing"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(stage_dx_iv, regimen_drugs_abbrev_pre, regimen_drugs_group_pre) %>%
  summarize(n_reg_pre = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # group_by(stage_dx_iv) %>%
  # arrange(stage_dx_iv, desc(n_reg_pre)) %>%
  # # slice_max(n = 5, order_by = n_reg) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    regimen_drugs_abbrev = case_when(
      n_reg_pre <= 5 ~ "Other",
      n_reg_pre > 5 ~ regimen_drugs_abbrev_pre
    ),
    regimen_drugs_group = case_when(
      n_reg_pre <= 5 ~ "Other",
      n_reg_pre > 5 ~ regimen_drugs_group_pre
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("drugs_pre")) %>%
  group_by(stage_dx_iv, regimen_drugs_abbrev, regimen_drugs_group) %>%
  summarize(n_reg = sum(n_reg_pre)) %>%
  arrange(stage_dx_iv, desc(n_reg)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    `Drug regimen` = regimen_drugs_abbrev,
    `Drug regimen group` = regimen_drugs_group,
    `Number of patients` = n_reg
  )

tbl_top_first_reg_by_stage <- map(
  top_first_reg_by_stage %>%
    group_split(stage_dx_iv),
  gt::gt
)
```

<!-- ## Sunburst plots -->

<!-- *The innermost circle of the sunburst plot indicates the first therapies that patients received following diagnosis. The circle is divided proportionally based on the percentage of patients that received a particular treatment. Each subsequent ring of the sunburst corresponds to a subsequent treatment regimen, such that the inner rings represent earlier treatments. Together, the rings illustrate the distribution and patterns of various treatment regimens (https://genie-bpc.github.io/genieBPC/articles/drug_regimen_sunburst_vignette.html).* -->

# Survival analysis

*All survival analyses have been adjusted for left truncation, such that patients enter the risk set at the time of NGS report. For PFS analyses, patients who progressed prior to NGS report are excluded.*

## Overall survival from diagnosis by stage {.tabset .tabsetfade}

### Adjusted for left truncation

```{r, warning = FALSE}
tbl_os_n_stg <- df_panc_derived %>%
  select(stage_dx_iv) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),
    label = list(stage_dx_iv = "Stage")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(update = list(stat_0 ~ "**N**")) %>%
  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_os_n_event_stg <- df_panc_derived %>%
  filter(os_dx_status == 1) %>%
  select(stage_dx_iv) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),
    label = list(stage_dx_iv = "Stage")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(update = list(stat_0 ~ "**N event**")) %>%
  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_os_dx_stage <-
  survfit(
    Surv(
      time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
      event = os_dx_status
    ) ~ stage_dx_iv,
    data = df_panc_derived
  ) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = .5,
    label = list(stage_dx_iv = "Stage"),
    label_header = "**Median overall survival (months)**",
    estimate_fun = function(.x) gtsummary::style_sigfig(.x, digits = 2)
  )

left_trunc_os_stage <-
  summary(coxph(
    Surv(
      time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
      event = os_dx_status
    ) ~ stage_dx_iv,
    data = df_panc_derived
  ))

logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_stage_pre <- left_trunc_os_stage$sctest %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "rowname") %>%
  filter(rowname == "pvalue") %>%
  select(".") %>%
  unlist()

logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_stage <- case_when(
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_stage_pre < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_stage_pre >= 0.001 ~ as.character(round(logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_stage_pre, 3))
)

tbl_merge(list(tbl_os_n_stg, tbl_os_n_event_stg, tbl_os_dx_stage)) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ NA_character_) %>%
  modify_table_styling(
    columns = label,
    rows = label == "Stage",
    footnote = paste0(
      "Left truncation adjusted log-rank p-value: ",
      logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_stage
    )
  )
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
survfit2(
  Surv(
    time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
    time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
    event = os_dx_status
  ) ~ stage_dx_iv,
  data = df_panc_derived
) %>%
  ggsurvfit(
    theme = list(theme_classic(), theme(legend.position = "top"))
  ) +
  add_censor_mark() +
  add_risktable(risktable_stats = "n.risk") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 60), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 6)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#007CBA", "#DF4602", "#83276B", "#4C8B2B", "#9E9E98")) +
  labs(
    x = "Time from diagnosis (months)",
    y = "Probability of overall survival"
  )
```

## Overall survival from diagnosis of advanced disease {.tabset .tabsetfade}

The estimates below include patients with stage IV disease at diagnosis or stage I-III disease at diagnosis with subsequent distant metastasis.

### Adjusted for left truncation

```{r}
survfit(
  Surv(
    time = adv_disease_cpt_mos,
    time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
    event = os_adv_status
  ) ~ 1,
  data = df_panc_derived
) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
```

```{r}
df_panc_derived_genomic <- df_panc_derived %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    gen_dat_summary %>% janitor::clean_names(),
    by = c("cpt_genie_sample_id" = "sample_id")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    gen_dat_summary_oncokb %>% janitor::clean_names(),
    by = c("cpt_genie_sample_id" = "sample_id")
  ) %>%
  left_join(., identify_kras_g12d_g12r_g12v, by = c("record_id" = "patientId")) %>%
  left_join(., identify_kras_g12d_g12r_g12v_oncokb, by = c("record_id" = "patient_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    kras_type_g12d_g12r_g12v = case_when(
      kras == 1 & kras_g12c == 1 ~ "KRAS G12C",
      kras == 1 & kras_g12d == 1 ~ "KRAS G12D",
      kras == 1 & kras_g12r == 1 ~ "KRAS G12R",
      kras == 1 & kras_g12v == 1 ~ "KRAS G12V",
      kras == 1 & kras_q61 == 1 ~ "KRAS Q61",
      kras == 1 &
        (kras_g12c %in% c(0, NA) &
          kras_g12d %in% c(0, NA) &
          (kras_g12r %in% c(0, NA)) &
          (kras_g12v %in% c(0, NA)) &
          (kras_q61 %in% c(0, NA))
        ) ~ "KRASmut (non G12C/D/R/V/Q61)",
      kras == 0 ~ "KRASwt"
    ),
    kras_g12d_vs_other = case_when(
      kras == 1 & kras_g12d == 1 ~ "KRAS G12D",
      kras == 1 & kras_g12d == 0 ~ "Other KRAS mutation",
      kras == 0 ~ "KRASwt"
    ),
    kras_mut_vs_wt = case_when(
      kras == 1 ~ "KRASmut",
      kras == 0 ~ "KRASwt"
    ),
    tp53_mut_vs_wt = case_when(
      tp53 == 1 ~ "TP53mut",
      tp53 == 0 ~ "TP53wt"
    ),
    smad4_mut_vs_wt = case_when(
      smad4 == 1 ~ "SMAD4mut",
      smad4 == 0 ~ "SMAD4wt"
    ),
    cdkn2a_2b_mut_vs_wt = case_when(
      cdkn2a == 1 | cdkn2b == 1 ~ "CDKN2A/CDKN2Bmut",
      cdkn2a == 0 & cdkn2b == 0 ~ "CDKN2A/CDKN2Bwt",
      is.na(cdkn2a) & is.na(cdkn2b) ~ NA_character_
    ),
    any_brca_palb2 = case_when(
      brca1 == 1 | brca2 == 1 | palb2 == 1 ~ "BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2mut",
      brca1 == 0 & brca2 == 0 & palb2 == 0 ~ "BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2wt",
      is.na(brca1) & is.na(brca2) & is.na(palb2) ~ NA_character_
    ),
    any_ddr = case_when(
      arid1a == 1 |
        atm == 1 |
        bard1 == 1 |
        brca1 == 1 |
        brca2 == 1 |
        chek1 == 1 | fanca == 1 | palb2 == 1 | rad50 == 1 ~ "DDRmut",
      arid1a == 0 &
        atm == 0 &
        bard1 == 0 &
        brca1 == 0 &
        brca2 == 0 &
        chek1 == 0 & fanca == 0 & palb2 == 0 & rad50 == 0 ~ "DDRwt",
      is.na(arid1a) &
        is.na(atm) &
        is.na(bard1) &
        is.na(brca1) &
        is.na(brca2) &
        is.na(chek1) & is.na(fanca) & is.na(palb2) & is.na(rad50) ~ NA_character_
    ),
    kras_type_g12d_g12r_g12v_oncokb = case_when(
      kras_oncokb == 1 & kras_g12c_oncokb == 1 ~ "KRAS G12C oncogenic",
      kras_oncokb == 1 & kras_g12d_oncokb == 1 ~ "KRAS G12D oncogenic",
      kras_oncokb == 1 & kras_g12r_oncokb == 1 ~ "KRAS G12R oncogenic",
      kras_oncokb == 1 & kras_g12v_oncokb == 1 ~ "KRAS G12V oncogenic",
      kras_oncokb == 1 & kras_q61_oncokb == 1 ~ "KRAS Q61 oncogenic",
      kras_oncokb == 1 &
        (kras_g12c_oncokb %in% c(0, NA) &
          kras_g12d_oncokb %in% c(0, NA) &
          (kras_g12r_oncokb %in% c(0, NA)) &
          (kras_g12v_oncokb %in% c(0, NA)) &
          (kras_q61_oncokb %in% c(0, NA))
        ) ~ "KRASmut (non G12C/D/R/V/Q61, oncogenic)",
      kras_oncokb == 0 ~ "KRAS non-oncogenic/wt"
    ),
    kras_g12d_vs_other_oncokb = case_when(
      kras_oncokb == 1 & kras_g12d_oncokb == 1 ~ "KRAS G12D oncogenic",
      kras_oncokb == 1 & kras_g12d_oncokb == 0 ~ "Other oncogenic KRAS mutation",
      kras_oncokb == 0 ~ "KRAS non-oncogenic/wt"
    ),
    kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = factor(case_when(
      kras_oncokb == 1 ~ "KRAS oncogenic",
      kras_oncokb == 0 ~ "KRAS non-oncogenic/wt"
    ), levels = c("KRAS non-oncogenic/wt", "KRAS oncogenic")),
    tp53_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = factor(case_when(
      tp53_oncokb == 1 ~ "TP53 oncogenic",
      tp53_oncokb == 0 ~ "TP53 non-oncogenic/wt"
    ), levels = c("TP53 non-oncogenic/wt", "TP53 oncogenic")),
    smad4_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = factor(case_when(
      smad4_oncokb == 1 ~ "SMAD4 oncogenic",
      smad4_oncokb == 0 ~ "SMAD4 non-oncogenic/wt"
    ), levels = c("SMAD4 non-oncogenic/wt", "SMAD4 oncogenic")),
    cdkn2a_2b_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = factor(case_when(
      cdkn2a_oncokb == 1 | cdkn2b_oncokb == 1 ~ "CDKN2A/CDKN2B oncogenic",
      cdkn2a_oncokb == 0 & cdkn2b_oncokb == 0 ~ "CDKN2A/CDKN2B non-oncogenic/wt",
      is.na(cdkn2a_oncokb) & is.na(cdkn2b_oncokb) ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("CDKN2A/CDKN2B non-oncogenic/wt", "CDKN2A/CDKN2B oncogenic")),
    any_brca_palb2_oncokb = case_when(
      brca1_oncokb == 1 | brca2_oncokb == 1 | palb2_oncokb == 1 ~ "BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 oncogenic",
      brca1_oncokb == 0 & brca2_oncokb == 0 & palb2_oncokb == 0 ~ "BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 non-oncogenic/wt",
      is.na(brca1_oncokb) & is.na(brca2_oncokb) & is.na(palb2_oncokb) ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

## KRASmut vs. KRASwt {.tabset .tabsetfade}

### Adjusted for left truncation, restricted to oncogenic/likely oncogenic genes

```{r, warning = FALSE}
tbl_os_n_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb <- df_panc_derived_genomic %>%
  select(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),
    label = list(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = "KRAS status")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(update = list(stat_0 ~ "**N**")) %>%
  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_os_n_event_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb <- df_panc_derived_genomic %>%
  filter(os_dx_status == 1) %>%
  select(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),
    label = list(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = "KRAS status")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(update = list(stat_0 ~ "**N event**")) %>%
  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_os_dx_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb <-
  survfit(
    Surv(
      time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
      event = os_dx_status
    ) ~ kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb,
    data = df_panc_derived_genomic
  ) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = .5,
    label = list(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = "KRAS status"),
    label_header = "**Median overall survival (months)**",
    estimate_fun = function(.x) gtsummary::style_sigfig(.x, digits = 2)
  )

left_trunc_os_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb <-
  summary(coxph(
    Surv(
      time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
      event = os_dx_status
    ) ~ kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb,
    data = df_panc_derived_genomic
  ))

logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_kras_type_mut_wt_pre_oncokb <-
  left_trunc_os_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb$sctest %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "rowname") %>%
  filter(rowname == "pvalue") %>%
  select(".") %>%
  unlist()

logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb <- case_when(
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_kras_type_mut_wt_pre_oncokb < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_kras_type_mut_wt_pre_oncokb >= 0.001 ~ as.character(round(logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_kras_type_mut_wt_pre_oncokb, 3))
)

tbl_merge(
  list(
    tbl_os_n_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb,
    tbl_os_n_event_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb,
    tbl_os_dx_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb
  )
) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ NA_character_) %>%
  modify_table_styling(
    columns = label,
    rows = label == "KRAS status",
    footnote = paste0(
      "Left truncation adjusted log-rank p-value: ",
      logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb
    )
  )
```

## Overall survival from diagnosis by DDRmut (DNA damage repair) vs. DDRwt {.tabset .tabsetfade}

**The analysis below was not annotated to OncoKB.**

DNA damage repair genes (DNA) were defined as: ARID1A, ATM, BARD1, BRCA1/2, CHEK1, FANCA, PALB2, RAD50.

Note: `r nrow(df_panc_derived_genomic %>% filter(is.na(any_ddr)))` patients with unknown DDR alteration status were omitted from the analysis below. 

### Adjusted for left truncation

```{r}
tbl_os_n_ddr_mut_wt <- df_panc_derived_genomic %>%
  filter(!is.na(any_ddr)) %>%
  select(any_ddr) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),
    label = list(any_ddr = "DDR status")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(update = list(stat_0 ~ "**N**")) %>%
  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_os_n_event_ddr_mut_wt <- df_panc_derived_genomic %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(any_ddr),
    os_dx_status == 1
  ) %>%
  select(any_ddr) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),
    label = list(any_ddr = "DDR status")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(update = list(stat_0 ~ "**N event**")) %>%
  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_os_dx_ddr_mut_wt <-
  survfit(
    Surv(
      time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
      event = os_dx_status
    ) ~ any_ddr,
    data = df_panc_derived_genomic %>%
      filter(!is.na(any_ddr))
  ) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = .5,
    label = list(any_ddr = "DDR status"),
    label_header = "**Median overall survival (months)**",
    estimate_fun = function(.x) gtsummary::style_sigfig(.x, digits = 2)
  )

left_trunc_os_ddr <-
  summary(coxph(
    Surv(
      time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
      event = os_dx_status
    ) ~ any_ddr,
    data = df_panc_derived_genomic
  ))

logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_ddr_pre <-
  left_trunc_os_ddr$sctest %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "rowname") %>%
  filter(rowname == "pvalue") %>%
  select(".") %>%
  unlist()

logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_ddr <- case_when(
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_ddr_pre < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_ddr_pre >= 0.001 ~ as.character(
    round(logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_ddr_pre, 3)
  )
)

tbl_merge(
  list(
    tbl_os_n_ddr_mut_wt,
    tbl_os_n_event_ddr_mut_wt,
    tbl_os_dx_ddr_mut_wt
  )
) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ NA_character_) %>%
  modify_table_styling(
    columns = label,
    rows = label == "DDR status",
    footnote = paste0(
      "Left truncation adjusted log-rank p-value: ",
      logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_ddr
    )
  )
```

## Test: genomic Cox models

```{r, include = FALSE}
clinical_vars_to_model <- c(
  "age_dx",
  "stage_dx_iv",
  "ca_resect_status_derived_no_unknown",
  "naaccr_sex_code",
  "panc_histology_derived"
)

models_os_left_trunc_clinical <- list()

for (i in clinical_vars_to_model) {
  formula_os_left_trunc_clin <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time = dx_cpt_rep_mos, time2 = tt_os_dx_mos, os_dx_status) ~ dx_cpt_rep_mos + ", i))

  model_os_left_trunc_clin <- coxph(formula_os_left_trunc_clin, data = df_panc_derived_genomic) %>%
    tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    add_global_p()

  models_os_left_trunc_clinical[[i]] <- model_os_left_trunc_clin
}

tbl_body_models_os_left_trunc_clinical <- tbl_stack(models_os_left_trunc_clinical)

df_models_os_left_trunc_clin <- tbl_body_models_os_left_trunc_clinical$table_body %>%
  filter(variable != "dx_cpt_rep_mos") %>%
  select(variable, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  arrange(variable) %>%
  mutate(pval_signif = case_when(
    p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p.value >= 0.05 ~ ""
  ))
```

The models adjusted for left truncation below include each gene of interest + stage (I-III vs. IV) + resectability status + time to genomic sequencing (to account for possible dependent left truncation).

The models without left truncation adjustment below include each gene of interest + stage (I-III vs. IV) + resectability status.

```{r}

  top_25_alt_oncokb %>%

    unlist(),

  "palb2_oncokb"
)
```

```{r, include = FALSE, eval=F}
models_os_left_trunc_oncokb <- list()

for (i in genes_to_model_oncokb) {
  
  formula_os_left_trunc <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time = dx_cpt_rep_mos, time2 = tt_os_dx_mos, os_dx_status) ~ dx_cpt_rep_mos + stage_dx_iv + ca_resect_status_derived_no_unknown + ", gsub("-", "_", i)))

  model_os_left_trunc <- coxph(formula_os_left_trunc, data = df_panc_derived_genomic) %>%
    tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE)

  models_os_left_trunc_oncokb[[i]] <- model_os_left_trunc
}

tbl_body_models_os_left_trunc_oncokb <- tbl_stack(models_os_left_trunc_oncokb)

df_models_os_left_trunc_oncokb <- tbl_body_models_os_left_trunc_oncokb$table_body %>%
  filter(
    !(variable %in% c("dx_cpt_rep_mos", "ca_resect_status_derived_no_unknown", "stage_dx_iv")),
    !is.na(estimate)
  ) %>%
  select(variable, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  arrange(variable) %>%

    pval_signif = case_when(
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      p.value >= 0.05 ~ ""
    ),
    variable_clean = str_to_upper(gsub("_oncokb", "", variable))
  )

write.csv(
  df_models_os_left_trunc_oncokb,

)
```

## PFS from stage IV diagnosis {.tabset .tabsetfade}

The estimates below is restricted to patients diagnosed with stage IV disease.

PFS event definitions:

- PFS-I: An event was defined by a progression according to radiologist assessment or death.
- PFS-M: An event was defined by a progression according to medical oncologist assessment or death.
- PFS-I-and-M: An event was defined by progression according to radiologist assessment and medical oncologist assessment or death.
- PFS-I-or-M: An event was defined by progression according to radiologist assessment or medical oncologist assessment or death.

**Patients whose NGS report was returned after their time to PFS are excluded from the analyses below.**

### Adjusted for left truncation

```{r}
tbl_med_pfs_i_adv <- survfit(
  Surv(
    time = adv_disease_cpt_mos,
    time2 = tt_pfs_i_adv_mos,
    event = pfs_i_adv_status
  ) ~ 1,
  data = df_panc_derived %>%
    filter(
      tt_pfs_i_adv_mos >= adv_disease_cpt_mos,
      stage_dx_iv == "Stage IV"
    )
) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = .5,
    label_header = "**Median PFS (months)**",
    estimate_fun = function(.x) {
      gtsummary::style_sigfig(.x, digits = 2)
    }
  ) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  add_nevent()

tbl_med_pfs_m_adv <- survfit(
  Surv(
    time = adv_disease_cpt_mos,
    time2 = tt_pfs_m_adv_mos,
    event = pfs_m_adv_status
  ) ~ 1,
  data = df_panc_derived %>%
    filter(
      tt_pfs_m_adv_mos >= adv_disease_cpt_mos,
      stage_dx_iv == "Stage IV"
    )
) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = .5,
    label_header = "**Median PFS (months)**",
    estimate_fun = function(.x) {
```

## PFS from initiation of first regimen post distant metastasis 

**Patients whose NGS report was returned after their time to PFS are excluded from the analyses below.**

```{r}
df_first_reg_post_dmets <- df_panc_derived_genomic %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    cohort_panc_v1_0$cohort_ca_drugs,
    by = c("cohort", "record_id", "institution", "ca_seq")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pfs_cohort)) %>%
  mutate(
    dx_to_adv_disease_days = case_when(
      pfs_cohort == "Stage IV" ~ 0,
      pfs_cohort == "Stage I-III with Distant Mets" ~ dx_to_dmets_days
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(dx_reg_start_int >= dx_to_adv_disease_days) %>%
  group_by(cohort, record_id, institution, ca_seq) %>%
  slice_min(dx_reg_start_int, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    ## calculate time from regimen start to CPT report
    reg_start_cpt_rep_mos_pre = dx_cpt_rep_mos - dx_reg_start_int_mos,
    reg_start_cpt_rep_mos = case_when(
      reg_start_cpt_rep_mos_pre < 0 ~ 0,
      reg_start_cpt_rep_mos_pre >= 0 ~ reg_start_cpt_rep_mos_pre
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(tt_pfs_i_and_m_g_mos > reg_start_cpt_rep_mos) %>%
  select(-reg_start_cpt_rep_mos_pre) %>%
  left_join(., regimen_abbreviations, by = "regimen_drugs") %>%
  mutate(
    regimen_drugs_abbrev = case_when(
      !is.na(abbreviation) ~ abbreviation,
      regimen_drugs %in% c(
        "Gemcitabine Hydrochloride",
        "Gemcitabine Hydrochloride, Nabpaclitaxel"
      ) ~ "Gemcitabine Hydrochloride with/without Nabpaclitaxel",
      is.na(abbreviation) ~ regimen_drugs
    ),
    regimen_drugs_group = case_when(
      regimen_drugs_abbrev %in% c("FOLFOX", "FOLFOXIRI", "FOLFIRI", "Capecitabine") ~ "5FU-containing",
      grepl("Gemcitabine Hydrochloride", regimen_drugs_abbrev) ~ "Gemcitabine-containing"
    )
  )
```

```{r, message = FALSE}
if (nrow(df_first_reg_post_dmets %>% janitor::get_dupes(record_id)) > 0) {
  print("At least one patient has >1 row in the `df_first_reg_post_dmets` dataset")
}
```

### PFS-I-and-M by KRASmut vs. KRASwt {.tabset .tabsetfade}

Most common 1L drug regimens by KRASmut vs. KRASwt

```{r}
df_first_reg_post_dmets %>%
  filter(pfs_cohort == "Stage IV") %>%
  group_by(kras_mut_vs_wt, regimen_drugs_abbrev, regimen_drugs_group) %>%
  summarize(n_pts_reg = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(kras_mut_vs_wt) %>%
  slice_max(n = 3, order_by = n_pts_reg, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    kras_mut_vs_wt = "KRASmut vs. KRASwt",
    regimen_drugs_abbrev = "Drug regimen",
    regimen_drugs_group = "Drug regimen group",
    n_pts_reg = "N patients"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    data_row.padding = gt::px(1),
    summary_row.padding = gt::px(1),
    grand_summary_row.padding = gt::px(1),
    footnotes.padding = gt::px(1),
    source_notes.padding = gt::px(1),
    row_group.padding = gt::px(1)
  )
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
tbl_pfs_n_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb <- df_first_reg_post_dmets %>%

  select(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),

    pfs_i_and_m_g_status == 1
  ) %>%
  select(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),
    label = list(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = "KRASmut vs. KRASwt")
  ) %>%

  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_pfs_reg_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb <-
  survfit(
    Surv(
      time = reg_start_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_pfs_i_and_m_g_mos,
      event = pfs_i_and_m_g_status
    ) ~ kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb,
    data = df_first_reg_post_dmets %>%
      filter(pfs_cohort == "Stage IV")
  ) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = .5,
    label = list(kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb = "KRASmut vs. KRASwt"),

    estimate_fun = function(.x) gtsummary::style_sigfig(.x, digits = 2)

left_trunc_pfs_kras_oncokb <-
  summary(coxph(
    Surv(
      time = reg_start_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_pfs_i_and_m_g_mos,
      event = pfs_i_and_m_g_status
    ) ~ kras_mut_vs_wt_oncokb,
    data = df_first_reg_post_dmets %>%
      filter(pfs_cohort == "Stage IV")
  ))

logrank_pval_left_trunc_pfs_kras_pre_oncokb <-
  left_trunc_pfs_kras_oncokb$sctest %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "rowname") %>%
  filter(rowname == "pvalue") %>%
  select(".") %>%
  unlist()

logrank_pval_left_trunc_pfs_kras_oncokb <- case_when(
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_pfs_kras_pre_oncokb < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_pfs_kras_pre_oncokb >= 0.001 ~ as.character(
    round(logrank_pval_left_trunc_pfs_kras_pre_oncokb, 3)
  )
)

tbl_merge(
  list(
    tbl_pfs_n_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb,
    tbl_pfs_n_event_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb,
    tbl_pfs_reg_kras_type_mut_wt_oncokb
  )
) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ NA_character_) %>%
  modify_table_styling(
    columns = label,
    rows = label == "KRASmut vs. KRASwt",
    footnote = paste0(
      "Left truncation adjusted log-rank p-value: ",
      logrank_pval_left_trunc_pfs_kras_oncokb
    )
  )
```

### PFS-I-and-M by CDKN2A/CDKN2B status {.tabset .tabsetfade}

*Note: `r nrow(df_first_reg_post_dmets %>% filter(is.na(cdkn2a_2b_mut_vs_wt)))` patients with unknown CDNK2A/CDKN2B status were omitted from the analysis below.* 

Most common 1L drug regimens by CDNK2A/CDKN2B status

```{r}
df_first_reg_post_dmets %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cdkn2a_2b_mut_vs_wt),
    pfs_cohort == "Stage IV"
  ) %>%
  group_by(cdkn2a_2b_mut_vs_wt, regimen_drugs_abbrev, regimen_drugs_group) %>%
  summarize(n_pts_reg = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(cdkn2a_2b_mut_vs_wt) %>%
  slice_max(n = 3, order_by = n_pts_reg, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    cdkn2a_2b_mut_vs_wt = "CDKN2A/CDKN2B status",
    regimen_drugs_abbrev = "Drug regimen",
    regimen_drugs_group = "Drug regimen group",
    n_pts_reg = "N patients"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    data_row.padding = gt::px(1),
    summary_row.padding = gt::px(1),
    grand_summary_row.padding = gt::px(1),
    footnotes.padding = gt::px(1),
    source_notes.padding = gt::px(1),
    row_group.padding = gt::px(1)
  )
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
    round(logrank_pval_left_trunc_pfs_ddr_pre, 3)
  )
)

tbl_merge(
  list(
    tbl_pfs_n_ddr_mut_wt,
    tbl_pfs_n_event_ddr_mut_wt,
    tbl_pfs_reg_ddr_mut_wt
  )
) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ NA_character_) %>%
  modify_table_styling(
    columns = label,
    rows = label == "DDR status",
    footnote = paste0(
      "Left truncation adjusted log-rank p-value: ",
      logrank_pval_left_trunc_pfs_ddr
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# stack together MSK germline alterations (known to be germline per cBio data)
# with DFCI, VICC, UHN likely germline alterations (these are the annotations from Henry since germline data not available from other institutions)
df_pathogenic_germline_panc <- msk_impact_brca1_brca2_palb2$mutation %>%
  filter(hugoGeneSymbol %in% c("BRCA1", "BRCA2", "PALB2")) %>%
  left_join(
    .,
    df_cbio_clin_data %>% select(patient_id, sample_id, x12_245_part_c_consented),
    by = c("patientId" = "patient_id", "sampleId" = "sample_id")
  ) %>%
  ## merge on analytic cohort
  left_join(
    .,
    df_panc_derived %>%
      filter(institution == "MSK") %>%
      rename(
        record_id_orig = record_id,
        cpt_genie_sample_id_orig = cpt_genie_sample_id
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        record_id = gsub("GENIE-MSK-", "", record_id_orig),
        cpt_genie_sample_id = gsub("GENIE-MSK-", "", cpt_genie_sample_id_orig),
        analytic_cohort = 1
      ) %>%
      select(record_id, cpt_genie_sample_id, analytic_cohort),
    by = c("patientId" = "record_id", "sampleId" = "cpt_genie_sample_id")
  ) %>%
  ## filter on samples in analytic cohort
  filter(analytic_cohort == 1) %>%
  filter(mutationStatus == "GERMLINE") %>%
  select(
    hugoGeneSymbol,
    sampleId,
    patientId,
    center,
    proteinChange,
    variantType,
    keyword
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    .,
    hrd_maf_henry %>%
      filter(Germline_Call == "Germline") %>% 
      # filter(Likely_Germline == 1) %>%
      select(
        Hugo_Symbol,
        Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
        # patientId,
        center,
        # proteinChange,
        variant_type, #variantType,
        # keyword
      ) %>%
      rename(hugoGeneSymbol = Hugo_Symbol, sampleId = Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>% 
      mutate(patientId = case_when(
        grepl("MSK", sampleId) ~ str_extract(sampleId, "^GENIE-MSK-P-\\d+(?-)"),
        grepl("UHN-OCT", sampleId) ~ str_extract(sampleId, "^GENIE-UHN-OCT\\d+(?-)"),
        TRUE ~ str_extract(sampleId, "^GENIE-[[:alpha:]]+-\\d+(?-)")),
             proteinChange = "If we need this variable, ask Henry which column of the updated annotation file corresponds",
             keyword = "If we need this variable, ask Henry which column of the updated annotation file corresponds")
  )
```

There are `r nrow(df_pathogenic_germline_panc)` BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2mut patients with likely germline/known germline pathogenic variants:

## Overall survival from diagnosis by BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2mut status

Adjusted for left truncation, restricted to oncogenic/likely oncogenic genes

```{r}
df_germline_analysis_derived <- df_panc_derived_genomic %>%
  select(
    record_id,
    cpt_genie_sample_id,
    any_brca_palb2_oncokb,
    os_dx_status,
    tt_os_dx_mos,
    dx_cpt_rep_mos
  ) %>%
  left_join(.,
    df_pathogenic_germline_panc %>%
      mutate(
        pathogenic_germline_pre = 1,
        record_id = case_when(
          center == "MSKCC" ~ paste0("GENIE-MSK-", patientId),
          TRUE ~ patientId
        ),
        cpt_genie_sample_id = case_when(
          center == "MSKCC" ~ paste0("GENIE-MSK-", sampleId),
          TRUE ~ sampleId
        )
      ),
    by = c("record_id", "cpt_genie_sample_id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pathogenic_germline = case_when(
      pathogenic_germline_pre == 1 ~ 1,
      is.na(pathogenic_germline_pre) ~ 0
    ),
    brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ = case_when(
      pathogenic_germline == 1 ~ "HRD pathogenic variant",
      pathogenic_germline == 0 & any_brca_palb2_oncokb == "BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 oncogenic" ~ "HRD oncogenic",
      pathogenic_germline == 0 & any_brca_palb2_oncokb == "BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 non-oncogenic/wt" ~ "HRD non-oncogenic/wt",
    )
  )
```

```{r}
  modify_header(update = list(stat_0 ~ "**N**")) %>%
  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_os_n_event_brca_palb2_germline <- df_germline_analysis_derived %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ),
    os_dx_status == 1
  ) %>%
  select(brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(everything() ~ "{n}"),
    label = list(brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ = "BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 status")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(update = list(stat_0 ~ "**N event**")) %>%
  modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA)

tbl_os_dx_brca_palb2_germline <-
  survfit(
    Surv(
      time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
      event = os_dx_status
    ) ~ brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ,
    data = df_germline_analysis_derived %>%
      filter(!is.na(brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ))
  ) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = .5,
    label = list(brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ = "BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 status"),
    label_header = "**Median overall survival (months)**",
    estimate_fun = function(.x) gtsummary::style_sigfig(.x, digits = 2)
  )

tbl_merge(
  list(
    tbl_os_n_brca_palb2_germline,
    tbl_os_n_event_brca_palb2_germline,
    tbl_os_dx_brca_palb2_germline
  )
) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ NA_character_) # %>%

## calculate pval between oncogenic vs. wt groups (pathogenic germline excluded)
left_trunc_os_brca_palb2_germline <-
  summary(coxph(
    Surv(
      time = dx_cpt_rep_mos,
      time2 = tt_os_dx_mos,
      event = os_dx_status
    ) ~ brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ,
    data = df_germline_analysis_derived %>%
      filter(
        brca_palb2_oncokb_path_germ != "HRD pathogenic variant"
      )
  ))

logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_brca_palb2_germline_pre <-
  left_trunc_os_brca_palb2_germline$sctest %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "rowname") %>%
  filter(rowname == "pvalue") %>%
  select(".") %>%
  unlist()

logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_brca_palb2_germline <- case_when(
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_brca_palb2_germline_pre < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
  logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_brca_palb2_germline_pre >= 0.001 ~ as.character(
    round(logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_brca_palb2_germline_pre, 3)
  )
)
```

*Left truncation adjusted log-rank p-value for assessing difference in OS between BRCA1/2/PALB2 oncogenic vs. BRCA1/2/wt patients (excluding patients with pathogenic variants): `r logrank_pval_left_trunc_os_brca_palb2_germline`.*

# Save tables 

```{r}
tbl_genomic_freq <- gen_dat_tested_20pct_pts_oncokb %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("_oncokb", "", .), -sample_id) %>%
  select(
    sample_id,
    KRAS,
    TP53,
    # CDKN2A,
    SMAD4,
    # CDKN2B,
    MTAP,
    ARID1A,
    KDM6A,
    RNF43,
    ATM,
    # BRCA2,
    AKT2,
    MYC
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(-sample_id),
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarize(
    n_tested = n(),
    n_alt = sum(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_alt = round((n_alt / n_tested) * 100, 2),
    value_clean = paste0(n_alt, "/", n_tested, " (", pct_alt, "%)")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_alt)) %>%
  select(name, value_clean) %>%
  gt::gt()

tbl_genomic_freq2 <- df_panc_derived_genomic %>%
  select(cdkn2a_2b_mut_vs_wt_oncokb, any_brca_palb2_oncokb) %>%
  tbl_summary()

save(
  tbl_genomic_freq,
  tbl_genomic_freq2,
  tbl1,
  tbl_cox_os,
  tbl_cox_pfs,
  file = here::here(
    "documents", "output", paste0("tables_", Sys.Date(), ".rdata")
  )
)
```
